offers.sharing_description: 12Build is a construction procurement platform connecting general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and Denmark. We manage the full procurement workf

en.description:
12Build is a construction procurement platform connecting general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and Denmark. We manage the full procurement workflow, from tender to subcontractor selection, and we compete on network depth: the more of the construction chain that runs through 12Build, the harder our position is to replicate.

Our core markets are the Netherlands and Belgium, and we're actively expanding into Germany and Denmark. That expansion is where this role comes in.
en.title: Sr. International Marketing manager
en.requirements:
Must-have

  • 5–7 years in B2B marketing with a track record in localization, regional marketing, or international market development.

  • Deep cultural fluency in at least two of our growth markets (Belgium, Germany, Denmark), with working English plus at least one of German or Danish. Dutch is a pré.

  • A demonstrated ability to adapt product marketing and go-to-market plans for regional audiences — not just translate them.
